title: Monotonic Array
goal: Decide whether the entire array is nondecreasing or nonincreasing.
strategy: Track two candidates: nondecreasing and nonincreasing. Each strict comparison can eliminate one candidate.

phasePurposes.inspect: Track two candidates: nondecreasing and nonincreasing. Each strict comparison can eliminate one candidate.
phasePurposes.update: Equal adjacent values do not break either monotonic direction.
phasePurposes.done: Equal adjacent values do not break either monotonic direction.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
